meta.title: How it works — Agental Casting
meta.description: From brief to call-in: how Agental filters 90% of applications to present you only the truly relevant profiles.

hero.title: How Agental Casting works
hero.subtitle: A brief structured in minutes, a calibrated short-list, profiles ready to decide on. Neutrality proven in the product.

sections.title: A brief structured in minutes
sections.body: A conversational assistant asks the right questions and structures your request: role, gender where relevant, age range, physical type, language, accent, constraints, shooting window, location and budget. You attach your material, script, sides or visual references. You validate a clear preview before launching.

sections.title: A cascading selection, calibrated for relevance
sections.body: Your profiles are analysed in several passes. The first applies your strict criteria: language, age, mobility, availability. The second compares each retained profile with your ideal role and gives it a reasoned score. The last keeps only profiles above your relevance threshold, with a diversity rule that stops ten identical profiles reaching you.

sections.title: Profiles ready to decide on
sections.body: Every talent in your short-list arrives documented. Faithful, unretouched photo, score, provenance, estimated rate, confirmed availability. You open the full file: media, the self-tape for this role if one was shot, measurements, accents, languages, experience, and the precise reason for the match with your brief.

sections.title: You keep control, neutrality is guaranteed
sections.body: Availability is confirmed by the talent, image rights are validated, and self-tapes are verified. For a role involving a minor, a reinforced path guides you and displays the applicable protections. You decide on complete files, avoiding last-minute surprises.

summary.title: You keep control, neutrality is guaranteed
summary.body: The score is a starting point, and the decision is entirely yours. You reorder, you exclude, you add. Each talent's provenance stays visible, and the decision history lets you understand every ranking. An “external talents only” filter is available at any time.

items.a: The AI discards profiles that don't match your brief, to present you only the truly relevant candidates. It's a time saver, not an opaque sort: every ranking is justified.
Each talent receives a score from 0 to 100 with a readable justification (accent, availability, rights, distance to the ideal profile). The same calculation applies to every profile.
Yes, from the Pro plan: framing, quality and fit to the role are checked before they reach you.
It shows whether a talent is represented by Agental or sourced off-roster (external). Provenance is always visible, to prove the ranking isn't biased.
No. The same scoring and criteria apply whatever the source. An external talent can rank ahead of an Agental one.

items.q: Can I audit the ranking decisions?
items.a: Yes. Every decision stays traced and consultable: the audit trail is built into the product.

items.q: Does the free plan need a credit card?
items.a: No. The Free plan opens 1 active project and 50 filtered applications per month, no credit card.
The Pro plan is billed per active seat per month. You add or remove seats to match your team; Studio covers up to 5 seats.
Yes. No commitment: change plan or cancel whenever you like.
